note: 系列 A 例句軌 B1 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: I have finished all my homework for today.
items.zh: 我今天的功課都寫完了。

items.sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside.
items.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就待在室內。

items.sentence: If I had more time, I would read more books.
items.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我會讀更多書。

items.sentence: You should drink more water when it's hot.
items.zh: 天氣熱的時候你應該多喝水。

items.sentence: The girl who sits next to me is kind.
items.zh: 坐在我旁邊的女孩很善良。

items.sentence: This is the game that I like the most.
items.zh: 這是我最喜歡的遊戲。

items.sentence: My teacher said that we were doing well.
items.zh: 我的老師說我們表現得很好。

items.sentence: I have never been to another country before.
items.zh: 我以前從來沒去過別的國家。

items.sentence: We might go to the zoo this weekend.
items.zh: 我們這個週末可能會去動物園。

items.sentence: I have to finish my project by Friday.
items.zh: 我必須在星期五前完成我的專題。

items.sentence: If you practice every day, you will improve quickly.
items.zh: 如果你每天練習，你會進步得很快。

items.sentence: She has just arrived at the train station.
items.zh: 她剛剛抵達火車站。

items.sentence: I think learning a new language is really fun.
items.zh: 我覺得學一種新語言真的很有趣。

items.sentence: I was nervous before the test, but I felt ready.
items.zh: 考試前我很緊張，但我覺得準備好了。

items.sentence: Could you tell me how to get there?
items.zh: 你可以告訴我怎麼去那裡嗎？

items.zh: 我們昨晚看的那部電影很棒。

items.sentence: Have you ever tried to cook dinner by yourself?
items.zh: 你有自己煮過晚餐嗎？

items.sentence: If I were taller, I could reach the top shelf.
items.zh: 如果我長得更高，我就碰得到最上層的架子。

items.sentence: I am saving my money because I want a new bike.
items.zh: 我在存錢，因為我想要一台新腳踏車。

items.zh: 他告訴我他覺得好多了。

items.zh: 如果你覺得擔心，你應該告訴爸媽。

items.zh: 我們在這個鎮上住了五年。

items.sentence: I have a friend who can speak three languages.
items.zh: 我有一個會說三種語言的朋友。

items.sentence: If we leave now, we will catch the early bus.
items.zh: 如果我們現在出發，就能趕上早班公車。

items.sentence: I felt sad when my best friend moved away.
items.zh: 我最好的朋友搬走時我很難過。

items.sentence: The weather might change later this afternoon.
items.zh: 今天下午稍晚天氣可能會變。

items.sentence: I believe that everyone can learn from their mistakes.
items.zh: 我相信每個人都能從錯誤中學習。

items.sentence: We had to wait a long time for the train.
items.zh: 我們必須等很久才等到火車。

items.sentence: I have read that book three times already.
items.zh: 那本書我已經讀過三次了。

items.sentence: I hope that we will win the match on Saturday.
items.zh: 我希望我們星期六能贏得比賽。

items.zh: 那部電影我已經看過兩次了。

items.sentence: She has worked here since last summer.
items.zh: 她從去年夏天就在這裡工作了。

items.sentence: We haven't decided where to go yet.
items.zh: 我們還沒決定要去哪裡。

items.sentence: If I win the prize, I will share it with you.
items.zh: 如果我得獎，我會跟你分享。

items.sentence: If you studied harder, you would pass the exam.
items.zh: 如果你更用功，你就會通過考試。

items.sentence: You could ask the teacher if you don't understand.
items.zh: 如果你不懂，可以問老師。

items.sentence: We might visit my grandparents during the holiday.
items.zh: 假期時我們可能會去看祖父母。

items.sentence: I have to wake up early for school tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天要上學，我必須早起。

items.zh: 他說他晚點會打給我。

items.zh: 幫我們修車的那個人很友善。

items.zh: 這就是我叔叔蓋的房子。

items.sentence: I really enjoy spending time with my family.
items.zh: 我很喜歡和家人共度時光。

items.zh: 她告訴我表演已經開始了。

items.sentence: Have you ever ridden a horse before?
items.zh: 你以前騎過馬嗎？

items.sentence: If it were warmer, we could swim in the lake.
items.zh: 如果天氣更暖，我們就能去湖裡游泳。

items.sentence: I am learning how to play the guitar.
items.zh: 我正在學怎麼彈吉他。

items.sentence: We should recycle more to protect the environment.
items.zh: 我們應該多回收來保護環境。

items.sentence: I feel proud when I help other people.
items.zh: 幫助別人的時候我感到驕傲。

items.sentence: The bag that I bought was quite expensive.
items.zh: 我買的那個包包相當貴。

items.sentence: My brother has grown taller than me.
items.zh: 我弟弟長得比我高了。

items.sentence: If we miss the bus, we will have to walk.
items.zh: 如果我們錯過公車，就得用走的。

items.sentence: I was disappointed that the trip was cancelled.
items.zh: 旅行被取消，我很失望。

items.sentence: The rain might stop before the game begins.
items.zh: 比賽開始前雨也許會停。

items.sentence: I think honesty is the most important thing.
items.zh: 我認為誠實是最重要的事。

items.sentence: We had to change our plans at the last minute.
items.zh: 我們必須在最後一刻改變計畫。

items.sentence: She has lost her keys somewhere in the park.
items.zh: 她把鑰匙掉在公園某個地方了。

items.sentence: I have a cousin who lives near the beach.
items.zh: 我有個住在海邊附近的表親。

items.sentence: If you ask nicely, she will probably help you.
items.zh: 如果你好好地問，她大概會幫你。

items.sentence: I felt relieved when the dentist said I was fine.
items.zh: 牙醫說我沒事時，我鬆了一口氣。

items.sentence: The students who finished early went outside.
items.zh: 提早做完的學生到外面去了。

items.sentence: I have been waiting for this day all week.
items.zh: 我整個星期都在等這一天。

items.sentence: He asked me if I wanted to join them.
items.zh: 他問我要不要加入他們。

items.sentence: You shouldn't leave your phone in the rain.
items.zh: 你不應該把手機留在雨中。

items.sentence: We have known each other since first grade.
items.zh: 我們從一年級就認識彼此了。

items.sentence: If I had a map, I wouldn't get lost.
items.zh: 如果我有地圖，就不會迷路了。

items.sentence: I am thinking about joining the swimming team.
items.zh: 我在考慮加入游泳隊。

items.sentence: She explained that the answer was quite simple.
items.zh: 她解釋說那個答案其實很簡單。

items.sentence: Have you finished reading the book I lent you?
items.zh: 我借你的那本書你讀完了嗎？

items.sentence: The restaurant that we tried was really busy.
items.zh: 我們試過的那家餐廳人很多。

items.sentence: I might need some help with this math problem.
items.zh: 這道數學題我可能需要一些幫忙。

items.sentence: We have planted many trees in our garden.
items.zh: 我們在花園裡種了很多樹。

items.sentence: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
items.zh: 如果你把藍色和黃色混在一起，就會變成綠色。

items.sentence: I was surprised that he remembered my birthday.
items.zh: 他記得我的生日，讓我很驚訝。

items.sentence: You have to be patient when you learn something new.
items.zh: 學新東西時你必須有耐心。

items.sentence: The teacher who taught us last year has retired.
items.zh: 去年教我們的那位老師退休了。

items.sentence: I hope the weather will be nice for the picnic.
items.zh: 我希望野餐那天天氣會好。

items.sentence: She said that she had never tasted mango before.
items.zh: 她說她以前從沒嘗過芒果。

items.sentence: We could meet at the library after lunch.
items.zh: 我們可以午餐後在圖書館碰面。

items.sentence: I have improved a lot since I started practicing.
items.zh: 自從我開始練習，進步了很多。

items.sentence: If everyone helps, we will finish much faster.
items.zh: 如果大家都幫忙，我們會完成得快很多。

items.sentence: My sister has broken her favorite coffee mug.
items.zh: 我姊姊把她最愛的咖啡杯打破了。

items.sentence: We have lived next door to them for ages.
items.zh: 我們住在他們隔壁已經很久了。

items.sentence: If I had a car, I would drive you home.
items.zh: 如果我有車，我就會載你回家。

items.sentence: You should apologize to her before it is too late.
items.zh: 你應該趁還來得及向她道歉。

items.sentence: The doctor who treated my father was very patient.
items.zh: 治療我爸爸的那位醫生非常有耐心。

items.sentence: This is the song that always makes me smile.
items.zh: 這就是那首總是讓我微笑的歌。

items.sentence: My coach told me that I had played really well.
items.zh: 我的教練告訴我，我打得非常好。

items.sentence: I have never tasted food this spicy before.
items.zh: 我以前從沒吃過這麼辣的食物。

items.sentence: We might take the train instead of the bus.
items.zh: 我們也許會改搭火車而不是公車。

items.sentence: You have to show your ticket at the gate.
items.zh: 你必須在閘門出示你的票。

items.sentence: If you leave the milk out, it will go bad.
items.zh: 如果你把牛奶放在外面，它就會壞掉。

items.sentence: The plane has just landed at the airport.
items.zh: 飛機剛剛降落在機場。

items.sentence: I think making friends takes time and effort.
items.zh: 我覺得交朋友需要時間和努力。

items.sentence: He was tired after work, but he still cooked dinner.
items.zh: 他下班後很累，但還是煮了晚餐。

items.sentence: Could you explain this rule to me again?
items.zh: 你可以再跟我解釋一次這條規則嗎？

items.zh: 掛在大廳裡的那幅畫非常古老。

items.sentence: Have you ever spoken in front of a large crowd?
items.zh: 你曾經在一大群人面前講過話嗎？

items.sentence: If I knew his number, I would call him now.
items.zh: 如果我知道他的電話號碼，我現在就會打給他。

items.sentence: I am collecting old coins from many countries.
items.zh: 我正在收集許多國家的舊硬幣。

items.sentence: She told me that the store closed at nine.
items.zh: 她告訴我那家店九點關門。

items.sentence: You should check the weather before you go hiking.
items.zh: 去健行前你應該先看天氣。

items.sentence: We have known this secret for a long time.
items.zh: 這個祕密我們已經知道很久了。

items.sentence: I have an aunt who paints beautiful pictures.
items.zh: 我有一位會畫出美麗圖畫的阿姨。

items.sentence: If we start early, we will avoid the traffic.
items.zh: 如果我們早點出發，就能避開車潮。

items.sentence: I felt scared when the lights suddenly went out.
items.zh: 燈突然熄掉時我覺得很害怕。

items.sentence: The power might come back on in a few minutes.
items.zh: 電力也許幾分鐘內就會恢復。

items.sentence: I believe that kindness can change someone's whole day.
items.zh: 我相信善意能改變一個人的一整天。

items.sentence: We had to carry the boxes up three floors.
items.zh: 我們必須把箱子搬上三層樓。

items.sentence: She has planted roses along the garden fence.
items.zh: 她沿著花園的籬笆種了玫瑰。

items.sentence: I hope that the package will arrive before Monday.
items.zh: 我希望包裹會在星期一前到。

items.sentence: They have already eaten all the cookies.
items.zh: 他們已經把餅乾全吃光了。

items.sentence: He has worked as a nurse since he left school.
items.zh: 他離開學校後就一直當護理師。

items.sentence: We haven't met our new neighbors yet.
items.zh: 我們還沒見過新鄰居。

items.sentence: If I pass the test, I will treat you to lunch.
items.zh: 如果我通過考試，我會請你吃午餐。

items.sentence: If you planned ahead, you would feel less stressed.
items.zh: 如果你事先規劃，你就會覺得壓力小一點。

items.sentence: You could borrow my umbrella if you need one.
items.zh: 如果你需要雨傘，可以借我的。

items.sentence: We might camp by the river next summer.
items.zh: 明年夏天我們也許會在河邊露營。

items.sentence: I have to return these books to the library today.
items.zh: 我今天必須把這些書還給圖書館。

items.sentence: He said that he would help us move the sofa.
items.zh: 他說他會幫我們搬沙發。

items.sentence: The woman who runs the bakery is my neighbor.
items.zh: 經營那家麵包店的女士是我的鄰居。

items.sentence: This is the bridge that connects the two towns.
items.zh: 這就是連接那兩個鎮的橋。

items.sentence: I really appreciate the way you listen to me.
items.zh: 我很感激你聆聽我的方式。

items.sentence: She told me that the meeting had been delayed.
items.zh: 她告訴我會議延後了。

items.sentence: Have you ever grown your own vegetables at home?
items.zh: 你曾經在家自己種過蔬菜嗎？

items.sentence: If it were quieter, I could focus on my work.
items.zh: 如果安靜一點，我就能專心工作。

items.sentence: I am training hard for the school sports day.
items.zh: 我正在為學校運動會努力訓練。

items.sentence: We should turn off the lights when we leave.
items.zh: 離開時我們應該把燈關掉。

items.sentence: I feel calm whenever I walk along the shore.
items.zh: 每當我沿著海岸散步，就覺得平靜。

items.sentence: The jacket that I ordered finally arrived today.
items.zh: 我訂的那件外套今天終於到了。

items.sentence: My cousin has become a very good swimmer.
items.zh: 我的表親現在游得很好了。

items.sentence: If we run out of bread, we will buy more.
items.zh: 如果我們的麵包用完了，就會再買一些。

items.sentence: I was annoyed that the printer kept jamming.
items.zh: 印表機一直卡紙，讓我很惱火。

items.sentence: The storm might pass before we reach the coast.
items.zh: 我們抵達海岸前風暴也許會過去。

items.sentence: I think patience is a skill worth learning.
items.zh: 我認為耐心是一項值得學習的技能。

items.sentence: We had to cancel the trip because of the snow.
items.zh: 因為下雪，我們必須取消那趟旅行。

items.sentence: She has saved enough money to buy a laptop.
items.zh: 她已經存夠錢買一台筆電了。

items.sentence: I have a teacher who makes history come alive.
items.zh: 我有一位讓歷史變得生動的老師。

items.sentence: If you speak slowly, everyone will understand you.
items.zh: 如果你說慢一點，大家都會聽懂你。

items.sentence: I felt grateful when strangers offered to help.
items.zh: 陌生人主動幫忙時，我心懷感激。

items.sentence: The children who cleaned up received a small reward.
items.zh: 幫忙整理的孩子得到了一份小獎勵。

items.sentence: I have been saving seats for my friends.
items.zh: 我一直在幫我的朋友占位子。

items.sentence: He asked me if I had finished the report.
items.zh: 他問我有沒有把報告寫完。

items.sentence: You shouldn't run beside the swimming pool.
items.zh: 你不應該在游泳池旁邊奔跑。

items.sentence: We have been neighbors since we were children.
items.zh: 我們從小就是鄰居。

items.sentence: If I had wings, I would fly over the mountains.
items.zh: 如果我有翅膀，我會飛越那些山。

items.sentence: I am considering studying abroad after graduation.
items.zh: 我在考慮畢業後出國念書。

items.sentence: She explained that the machine was easy to use.
items.zh: 她解釋說那台機器很容易操作。

items.sentence: Have you returned the tools you borrowed last week?
items.zh: 你上週借的工具還了嗎？

items.sentence: The hotel that we booked was close to the beach.
items.zh: 我們訂的那家旅館離海灘很近。

items.sentence: I might join the drama club this term.
items.zh: 這學期我也許會加入戲劇社。

items.sentence: We have decorated the classroom for the festival.
items.zh: 我們為了這個節慶把教室布置好了。

items.sentence: If you heat ice, it slowly turns into water.
items.zh: 如果你加熱冰塊，它會慢慢變成水。

items.sentence: I was amazed that she finished the puzzle so fast.
items.zh: 她這麼快就完成拼圖，讓我很驚奇。

items.sentence: You have to read the instructions before you begin.
items.zh: 開始之前你必須先讀說明。

items.sentence: The scientist who gave the talk was very inspiring.
items.zh: 發表那場演講的科學家非常激勵人心。

items.sentence: I hope the roads will be clear for our trip.
items.zh: 我希望我們旅行時路況順暢。

items.sentence: He said that he had lost his wallet on the bus.
items.zh: 他說他把錢包掉在公車上了。

items.sentence: We could share a taxi if we are heading the same way.
items.zh: 如果我們同方向，可以共乘一輛計程車。

items.sentence: I have grown more confident since I joined the choir.
items.zh: 自從加入合唱團，我變得更有自信了。

items.sentence: If everyone stays calm, we will solve this quickly.
items.zh: 如果大家保持冷靜，我們會很快解決這件事。

items.sentence: She has repaired the bike that I thought was broken.
items.zh: 她把我以為壞掉的那台腳踏車修好了。

items.sentence: If I were braver, I would speak up more often.
items.zh: 如果我更勇敢，就會更常發言。

items.sentence: You should warm up before you start running.
items.zh: 開始跑步前你應該先暖身。

items.sentence: The café that opened last month is already popular.
items.zh: 上個月開幕的那家咖啡館已經很受歡迎了。

items.sentence: Have you ever walked to school in heavy rain?
items.zh: 你曾經在大雨中走路去上學嗎？

items.sentence: He told me that the keys were under the mat.
items.zh: 他告訴我鑰匙在地墊下面。

items.sentence: We might need extra chairs for the guests.
items.zh: 我們也許需要多準備幾張椅子給客人。

items.sentence: I have to charge my phone before we leave.
items.zh: 出發前我必須幫手機充電。

items.sentence: The dog that followed us home was very friendly.
items.zh: 跟著我們回家的那隻狗非常友善。

items.sentence: If you forget your password, you can reset it online.
items.zh: 如果你忘記密碼，可以在線上重設。

items.sentence: She said that she had enjoyed the whole concert.
items.zh: 她說她很享受整場音樂會。

items.sentence: I felt embarrassed when I forgot his name.
items.zh: 我忘了他的名字時覺得很尷尬。

items.sentence: We have raised money for the local animal shelter.
items.zh: 我們為當地的動物收容所募了款。

items.sentence: You could try again tomorrow if today feels hard.
items.zh: 如果今天覺得吃力，明天可以再試一次。

items.sentence: The book that changed my mind was quite short.
items.zh: 那本改變我想法的書其實很短。

items.sentence: I have been trying to eat healthier this month.
items.zh: 這個月我一直在努力吃得更健康。

items.sentence: If we plant more trees, the air will get cleaner.
items.zh: 如果我們多種樹，空氣就會變得更乾淨。

items.sentence: He asked me if the library was still open.
items.zh: 他問我圖書館是不是還開著。

items.zh: 你應該每週備份你的檔案。

items.sentence: I think courage means trying even when you are afraid.
items.zh: 我認為勇氣是即使害怕也願意嘗試。
